properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - Be sure sinks are being used for designated purposes only: handwash sinks are for handwashing only, prep sinks for food prep only. -Ensure to limit time that TCS food is left out to keep it out of the temperature danger zone . - Do not stock above fill lines in prep top coolers. - Make sure all cold held time/temperature control for safety(TCS) food held for longer than 24 hours is being properly date marked with date opened or prepped and are being discarded by the 7th day or manufacturer's best-by date, whichever comes first. -TCS food thawed from frozen must have updated date mark upon removal from freezer. If food is frozen same day it is prepped, mark food with discard time 6 days from thaw date once removed from freezer. Compliance Schedule OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS You must complete the following items by the due date listed below . Your inspector will do a compliance inspection . If these items are not corrected, you will be billed for the inspection. Violations cited must be corrected within the time frames specified . Complete ByItem Number 06/10/2026 2600 Compliance with valid permit; operating and risk control plans and required written procedures. 2600 Observed in walk-in cooler whole uncut beef prime rib and individually portioned prime rib. Per employee, beef was cooked yesterday and stated it is cooked to 100F, moved to cool whole in the walk-in cooler, then cut and portioned, cooked on grill to order. Rib can be ordered mid-rare/undercooked per customer order. Observations and process described during today's inspection do not comply with cooking, cooling, or undercooking service standards in WAC 246-215 03400(2)a regarding whole meat roasts. All processes must be written and approved by the health department and follow food safety standards as established . Instructed facility to discard prime rib and portioned rib for safety. A compliance order has been issued to stop preparation of prime rib immediately . Failure to stop preparation of prime rib immediately will result in a $240 non-compliance fee. Facility must provide food preparation steps for prime rib roast that comply with the cooking, cooling, or undercooking service standards for review to food@tpchd.org or to inspector at dcaverly@tpchd.org. Prime rib educational handout provided in inspection report email. Contact your inspector with questions or if you need more time to complete these items.
